hypothesis: For Q8VNNI members' I16 input projection, precomputing each nonzero input times its column scale once per member-row avoids repeating that scalar multiply for each of the member's four or six output tiles.
treatment: Add one n_in-sized scratch vector per FastRnn member; precompute scaled nonzero inputs once, then preserve ascending nonzero-column order and the existing separate IEEE multiply/add accumulation in each tile.
explicit_exclusions: No shared nonzero scan with other projections.
No GRU fusion, YMM replacement, loop reordering, or other kernel changes.
No fast-math, FMA reassociation, skipped sequence rows, or model/weight changes.

frozen_comparison.measurement: One CPU, exact ZIP callback, 10 fixed complete 20,000-row sequences, two resets/passes per panel, alternating baseline/candidate order for at least two paired rounds; require bitwise replay and finite outputs.
frozen_comparison.portal_runtime_claim: None; this local Intel i9-11900H is not the competition AMD EPYC 9224.

correctness_checks.projection_parity: Bitwise output and nonzero-column order matched for I16 projection across ragged column counts and 1/3/4/13/384 output rows; VNNI test compares the six-tile Q8 member projection to AVX2 reference.
